_why: Campaign 5 of #4966: the nineteenth- and early-twentieth-century English rediscovery of alchemy, Hermeticism and the Rosicrucians — the spiritual-interpretation school (Atwood, Hitchcock), the historians of chemistry (Bolton, Muir, Redgrove, Ferguson's Bibliotheca Chemica), the occult revival (Waite, Westcott, Jennings, Hartmann, Kingsford, Heindel, Clymer, Plummer), and the translations they made (Böhme in English, the Hermetic Museum, Paracelsus in Waite's edition). Hartmann's homeopathy, Heindel's opera guide, Kingsford's diet, and the industrial-chemistry noise are OUT.
